name: Claim Guest Value
summary: Atomically attaches claimable guest-created value to the explicitly resolved durable identity.

preconditions.expression: guest-identity == active and claimable-value == claimable and durable-identity == resolved

setup: Resolve the durable identity through an independent authentication or registration journey.
Retain the originating guest-session and claimable-value bindings.

inputs.description: Explicit reference to the resolved durable identity receiving the guest value.
Stable operation key used to guarantee replay-safe claim behavior.

postconditions.expression: guest-identity == claimed and claimable-value == claimed and durable-identity == resolved
